passages.note: Bill history lists Martinez as a co-sponsor of HB2853, the 2022 ESA-expansion law.
House Third Reading passed HB2853 31-26-3-0-0; Martinez voted Y.

passages.provision_quote: Notwithstanding section 15-2401, beginning in the 2022-2023 school year, in this chapter, unless the context otherwise requires, "qualified student" includes a resident of this state who both: 1. Is eligible to enroll in a public school in this state in any of the following: ( a ) A preschool program for children with disabilities. ( b ) A kindergarten program. ( c ) Any of grades one through twelve. 2. Does not otherwise qualify for an Arizona empowerment scholarship account pursuant to this chapter.
passages.note: Enacted text adds ARS 15-2401.01, extending ESA eligibility to any student not already qualifying, usable at a qualified nongovernmental school.

rows.reasoning: Martinez co-sponsored HB2853 (2022) and voted Y on its House Third Reading (passed 31-26-3-0-0); the enacted text adds ARS 15-2401.01, making any Arizona student eligible for preschool-disability programs, kindergarten, or grades one through twelve who does not already qualify newly eligible for an empowerment scholarship account usable at a nongovernmental qualified school. This matches the rung 'Providing universal vouchers so that education funding follows the student to any school — public, private, or religious — chosen by the family.'
